page_title: CRY 2-2 MCI | Crystal Palace v Manchester City 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+4' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+3' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

89' That didn't go as planned. Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Stefan Ortega, who easily kept it out.
88' The resulting corner from Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the defence.
86' Substitution. Jack Grealish (Manchester City) on for Kevin De Bruyne.
84' Robert Jones blows his whistle and Rico Lewis (Manchester City) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
83' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
81' The linesman signals that Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
80' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
79' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Savinho will be replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
79' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is flagged for offside.
77' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ismaila Sarr.
77' The resulting corner, taken by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), comes to nothing.
77' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared.
76' Savinho (Manchester City) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Manchester City force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
75' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

74' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) comes onto the pitch for Eberechi Eze.
70' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Jones didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
68' 2 - 2 Rico Lewis (Manchester City) receives a delightful pass inside the box and fires the ball into the top left corner. What a lovely finish!
67' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
66' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) commits a rough foul. Robert Jones stops the game and makes a call. Crystal Palace win a free kick.
64' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
60' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
56' 2 - 1 Gooal! Will Hughes takes over corner duties. Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 2:1.
56' There's an opportunity for Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
55' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
47' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
43' The opposition back off Savinho (Manchester City) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!

41' It looks like Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Crystal Palace.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Crystal Palace in a dangerous position.
38' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is caught offside!
34' Dangerous play by Savinho (Manchester City). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
30' 1 - 1 Erling Haaland (Manchester City) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the left post.
29' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
26' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
25' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
25' Savinho (Manchester City) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.

24' OFF THE POST! Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
22' Flag goes up against Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
21' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner.
20' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
17' Robert Jones blows for a foul after Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Crystal Palace earn a free kick.

14' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
13' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
10' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' The game is interrupted now, Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' A pass into the box finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Dean Henderson denies him.
6' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
6' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
4' 1 - 0 Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable low shot into the middle of the net.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones will supervise the game today.
